title: SimplerCraft
description: Beautiful Minecraft Easy and Optimized for Beginners
body:
Beautiful Minecraft Easy and Optimized for Beginners

This mod pack includes a variety of optimization modes and maintains over 300fps frames with the native 12 chunk Voxy 512 chunk option in the RTX5060 desktop environment

! Disable Voxy mode if serious performance degradation occurs

! This mode pack uses Voxy mode. Voxy mode is not compatible with existing shaders and requires a supported dedicated shader installation, so please install a supported dedicated shader from the link below

[https://samalando.com/voxy/shaders](https://samalando.com/voxy/shaders)

! This modpack includes a Shoulder Surfing Reloaded mode, allowing you to experience a special third-person view. However, this could be the reason for the suspension on servers, including rival Hypixel, so play it in a first-person or default third-person view on rival servers

! Known incompatible modes
- Chunks fade in (conflict with Voxy only shader)

The source of all modes is in the link below

[https://modrinth.com/collection/98UOFQUh](https://modrinth.com/collection/98UOFQUh)

All the descriptions of this modpack have been translated into a translator and the developer is Korean!
